result.reason: The redline adds a professional-and-workmanlike services warranty, a 90-day software conformance warranty, repair/replacement/re-performance/refund remedies, and a no-malicious-code warranty. However, it omits the required compliance-with-laws warranty and does not clearly establish the playbook’s service-warranty duration or necessarily cover all Services. The software warranty trigger—“following the acceptance date and following delivery of any Revision or deliverable”—is also ambiguous and may create rolling warranty periods. The changes are otherwise targeted and preserve unrelated commercial intent.
